t: You're at London Victoria, a major central London railway terminus in the City of Westminster, with an Underground station connected to it. From here, trains run on the Brighton Main Line to Gatwick Airport and Brighton, and on the Chatham Main Line towards Ramsgate and Dover. Gatwick Express trains run direct to the airport. The station is named after the nearby Victoria Street, which in turn carries the name of Queen Victoria, who reigned from 1837 to 1901, longer than any monarch before her. So her name sits over one of London's great gateways to the south.
